title: Grateful Dead Live at RFK Stadium on 1973-06-10
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> CD D

ai_review.summary: An exceptional Charlie Miller soundboard transfer of a legendary 1973 marathon, highlighted by smoking Morning Dew, Dark Star, Bird Song and an unforgettable Box of Rain.
ai_review.review: The show is repeatedly described as one of the Dead's finest – a four‑hour‑plus performance bursting with epic jams, tight playing and classic ’73 setlists. Reviewers rave about the crystal‑clear Miller transfer, noting no audio flaws and praising the vivid capture of every moment.

ai_rating.rationale: All but one review gave 5 stars; comments uniformly praise both musical performance and soundboard quality, indicating an almost flawless experience.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Charlie Miller's transfer is called crystal‑clear, balanced and free of noticeable glitches; reviewers repeatedly thank Miller for the superb sound.

standout_songs: It Takes a Train to Cry
poor_songs: Round And Round / Johnny B. Goode
show_quality.setlist_flow: A sprawling three‑set marathon that moves from a powerful opening with Morning Dew through extended improvisations (notably Dark Star and Bird Song) to a soaring second set climax, ending with classic closers.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his perfect tone, patient restraint on the Not Fade solo, and overall rock‑n‑roll brilliance; described as “on” throughout.
band_member_comments.Phil: Strong vocal performance on Box of Rain with Donna Jean; a brief odd moment in Dark Star where he cues a song awkwardly is noted but not detrimental.
